description: Check VPN accessibility from different countries. Answers questions like "Can users in Iran connect to VPNs?" from tests run by Voidly probe nodes.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to check VPN accessibility FROM (e.g., IR for Iran, CN for China)

provider.description: VPN provider to filter by (voidly, nordvpn, protonvpn, mullvad)

name: check_vpn_accessibility
